Scientific Moorings - Southwest Coast - Hermitage Bay
Three subsurface oceanographic moorings have been deployed in Hermitage Bay in the vicinity of:
47 35.693N 055 53.965W
47 38.578N 055 45.431W
47 36.432N 055 50.154W
Top floatation at approximately 5-10 meters below the surface.
Caution.
